description: Use for 'what are the requirements/documents for a visa to X' — e.g. 'Paraguay residency visa requirements for US citizens', 'Thailand DTV requirements', 'what do I need for a Portugal D7'. Give `passport_country` and `destination_country` (ISO-3166 code or English name), optional `visa_type` filter. Uses passport-specific data when available and falls back to destination program data otherwise. Each result carries `official_link` and `data_as_of` (the date the row was last loaded, not a check of the rule; null when undated). To discover and rank which visa options exist for a route, use visa_check first.

destination_country.description: Country being travelled to: ISO-3166 alpha-2/alpha-3 code or English name, e.g. 'TH', 'THA', 'Thailand'.

passport_country.description: Country of the traveller's passport: ISO-3166 alpha-2/alpha-3 code or English name, e.g. 'SK', 'SVK', 'Slovakia'.

visa_type.description: Keyword filter on the visa type, e.g. 'digital nomad', 'work', 'visa_free'. Omit to get every option on file.

name: get_visa_requirements
title: Get visa requirements
